name: continente
description: Connect to Continente (continente.pt): search, products, order history, and one-click cart adds on your behalf
post_install: Reading works immediately — search and product lookups need no session.

To enable cart adds and order history, store a session: ask the agent 'set up continente'. The agent walks you through copying document.cookie from a logged-in browser and stores it in the vault (service continente.pt:cookies).
Panel: the Continente page in the dashboard — status probe + session form.
